source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of software development tools (PDF 28).

blocks.text: Software development tools software applications banane, test karne aur maintain karne (sambhalne) ke liye zaroori hain.
Yeh tools developers ko code likhne, ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek karne aur software projects achi tarah chalane mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Software development process mein development tools ki ahmiyat par baat karein. (Long Question 6) a) Language editors, translators aur debuggers ka kirdar bataein. b) Har ek ki misal dein aur bataein ke yeh kaam ko efficient aur durust kaise banate hain.
blocks.explanation: a) Language editors code likhne aur badalne ka aasan interface dete hain; translators (interpreters aur compilers) high-level code ko machine language mein badalte hain jo computer chala sake; debuggers code step by step chala kar aur variables dikha kar batate hain ke ghalti kahan hai. b) Misalein: editors: Notepad++, Sublime Text, VS Code; translators: Python interpreter, GCC; debuggers: GDB, Visual Studio Debugger. Editors likhna tez karte hain, translators code ko chalne ke qabil banate hain aur debuggers ghaltiyan jaldi pakarte hain; IDEs (jaise PyCharm) yeh sab ek jagah dete hain. Is se development tez aur zyada durust hoti hai.

items: Development tools: code likhne, test, debug aur projects sambhalne mein madad.
Aage: editors, translators, compilers, debuggers, IDEs, platforms, repositories.
